title: Inversions After Shuffle
statementMd:
You are given a permutation of integers from $1$ to $*n*$. Exactly once you apply the following operation to this permutation: pick a random segment and shuffle its elements. Formally:

1. Pick a random segment (continuous subsequence) from $*l*$ to $*r*$. All ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d1e518f954d040123b08a589daa8809cf25aae46.png) segments are equiprobable.
2. Let $*k* = *r* - *l* + 1$, i.e. the length of the chosen segment. Pick a random permutation of integers from $1$ to $*k*$, $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*k*}$. All $*k*!$ permutation are equiprobable.
3. This permutation is applied to elements of the chosen segment, i.e. permutation $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l* - 1}, *a*_{*l*}, *a*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*r* - 1}, *a*_{*r*}, *a*_{*r* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ is transformed to $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l* - 1}, *a*_{*l* - 1 + *p*_{1}}, *a*_{*l* - 1 + *p*_{2}}, ..., *a*_{*l* - 1 + *p*_{*k* - 1}}, *a*_{*l* - 1 + *p*_{*k*}}, *a*_{*r* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$.

Inversion if a pair of elements (not necessary neighbouring) with the wrong relative order. In other words, the number of inversion is equal to the number of pairs $(*i*, *j*)$ such that $*i* < *j*$ and $*a*_{*i*} > *a*_{*j*}$. Find the expected number of inversions after we apply exactly one operation mentioned above.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the length of the permutation.

The second line contains $*n*$ distinct integers from $1$ to $*n*$ — elements of the permutation.

## Output

Print one real value — the expected number of inversions. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 9}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c5e2d5f952bf0600d65151cbd23c801f49c2c594.png).
statementZhMd:
给定一个由 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 组成的排列。你需要对该排列恰好执行一次以下操作：随机选取一个连续区间，并将其中的元素打乱。具体来说：

1. 随机选取一个从 $*l*$ 到 $*r*$ 的连续区间。所有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d1e518f954d040123b08a589daa8809cf25aae46.png) 个区间被选中的概率相同。
2. 令 $*k* = *r* - *l* + 1$，即所选区间的长度。随机选取一个由 $1$ 到 $*k*$ 组成的排列 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*k*}$。所有 $*k*!$ 个排列被选中的概率相同。
3. 将该排列应用于所选区间中的元素，即将排列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l* - 1}, *a*_{*l*}, *a*_{*l* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*r* - 1}, *a*_{*r*}, *a*_{*r* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 变为 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l* - 1}, *a*_{*l* - 1 + *p*_{1}}, *a*_{*l* - 1 + *p*_{2}}, ..., *a*_{*l* - 1 + *p*_{*k* - 1}}, *a*_{*l* - 1 + *p*_{*k*}}, *a*_{*r* + 1}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。

如果一对元素（不一定相邻）的相对顺序错误，则称其构成一个逆序对。换句话说，逆序对的数量等于满足 $(*i*, *j*)$ 且 $*i* < *j*$、$*a*_{*i*} > *a*_{*j*}$ 的二元组数量。求恰好执行一次上述操作后，逆序对数量的期望值。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$）——排列的长度。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个两两不同的、范围在 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 之间的整数——排列中的元素。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数——逆序对数量的期望值。如果你的答案与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 9}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说：假设你的答案为 $*a*$，标准答案为 $*b*$。如果 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c5e2d5f952bf0600d65151cbd23c801f49c2c594.png)，则判定你的答案正确。
